Sections.9.4a: Parenteral Vasodilation Therapy in Patients Hospitalized With HF
Sections.Description: Intravenous nitroglycerin is recommended for treatment of decompensated heart failure. Randomized trials, cohort studies, and clinical registrations support this therapy.

Sections.9.4b: Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Prophylaxis in Hospitalized Patients
Sections.Description: Enoxaparin and unfractionated heparin are compared for their effectiveness in reducing VTEs. Rivaroxaban is another option in medically ill patients.

Sections.9.5: Evaluation and Management of Cardiogenic Shock
Sections.Description: Dobutamine and dopamine are evaluated for treating cardiogenic shock. Levosimendan is compared in various studies, and epinephrine use is discussed.
